title: Warrior Forge 12: Duo Edition (Hypertrophy-First Upper/Lower + Kettlebell Power + Heart Engine)
philosophy: Spine = Design 2 (judges' winner): an upper/lower split with a Zone-2 day in the middle, every visible muscle trained twice a week at a prescribed effort (reps-in-reserve), and load manufactured from light dumbbells with tempo, pauses, 1.5-reps, unilateral work, density and the vest. Grafted on top: Design 0's kettlebell discipline (StrongFirst hinge-before-swing chain, Turkish get-up skill ladder, Simple & Sinister swing density clock, two-hand rack for the 53 lb press, no week-1 max tests) and Design 1's machine-drivable data model (target grammar, SUCCESS/FAIL definitions, gate expressions, missed-training rules, vest as % bodyweight, one-ruck-variable-per-week). Every ladder now starts low enough for a smaller or weaker beginner: wall push-ups, chair sit-to-stand, 8 lb presses, 12 lb rows and goblets, two-hand DUMBBELL swings at 20 then 35 lb before the 53 lb bell is ever hiked. The 53 lb bell, the vest and running are milestones earned through exact form gates, per user. Cardio follows the AHA/HHS guideline (150 min/week moderate or 75 vigorous, plus muscle-strengthening on 2+ days). Two players share one program and one set of iron but own their ladder positions, XP, streaks and benchmark history; rivalry is scored on relative progress only.
why_this_gets_results_fast: Beginners adapt to almost any consistent stimulus, so the biggest levers are (1) showing up 6x/week with a plan that is always completable, (2) frequency: chest, back, shoulders, arms, glutes, quads, hamstrings, calves and core each hit twice weekly, (3) effective reps: RIR 3 -> 2 -> 1 across phases so the last reps of every set recruit high-threshold fibers, (4) double progression with auto-advance so no target sits stale more than two sessions, (5) load-gap engineering so 8->10->12->20->35->53 lb never stalls a lift, (6) conditioning that runs in parallel without stealing recovery: Zone 2 is easy by the talk test, one weekly interval day and short swing EMOMs raise VO2max and stamina fast, (7) Boss Battles every 4 weeks plus a duo scoreboard make progress visible, which drives adherence, which is what actually makes it fast.

phases.name: Phase 1: Recruit (Foundation & Form)
phases.goal: Own every pattern, pass the hinge gate and (for most users) the bell gate, build a Zone-2 base, earn first ladder steps. No max tests until the week-4 Boss Battle.
phases.what_changes: RIR 3 on every set; 3 s eccentric on dumbbell lifts; form checklists on hinge_deadlift, goblet_squat, push_up, hip_thrust, swing until ticked 2 sessions running. Vest locked everywhere. Swings are dumbbell swings (20 then 35 lb). Intervals locked to brisk-walk step 1 for weeks 1-2. Week 4 = deload (sets x0.6) + first Boss Battle on Saturday.

phases.name: Phase 2: Soldier (Build)
phases.goal: Real load: 53 lb bell in deadlift/swing/goblet/row as gates pass, vest unlocks per exercise, dumbbells 12->20->35 via tempo and 1.5-reps, Zone 2 to 33 min.
phases.what_changes: RIR 2; eccentric 2 s unless the step says otherwise; one ladder advance per exercise per session; intervals steps 2-4; Saturday swing block becomes 10-min EMOM when reached; Wednesday 33 min Zone 2. Week 8 = deload + Boss Battle 2.

phases.name: Phase 3: Warrior (Peak)
phases.goal: S&S density clock (100 swings toward 5:00), one-hand swings if earned, 35 lb presses, 53 lb goblets, vest push-ups/step-ups/walks, run intervals, get-ups with 20-35 lb. Final Boss Battle week 12.
phases.what_changes: RIR 1 on compounds; last set of isolations to RIR 0; rest timers on strength B cut 15 s (density); vest_walk replaces Zone 2 where unlocked; Wednesday 36 min; intervals steps 4-6. Week 12: Mon-Wed at 50% sets, Thu 25-min easy walk, Fri off, Sat final Boss Battle.

conditioning_protocols.name: Zone-2 engine (Wed main block + Mon/Thu finishers + Sat flush)
conditioning_protocols.protocol: Wednesday: 3 min ramp then 30/33/36 min (Phase 1/2/3) at the current treadmill_zone2 (or vest_walk) step at talk-test intensity. Monday 7 min and Thursday 8 min finishers at the same incline. Saturday 4 min flush after the core block. Warm-ups add 2-3 min of walking on strength days. Optional Sunday 20-30 min walk logs as Zone 2.
conditioning_protocols.progression: treadmill_zone2 ladder: incline first, then speed, then duration; advance after 2 sessions at RPE <= 4. vest_walk after Zone 2 step 4: one variable per week (time -> incline -> vest). Vest capped at min(20% BW, 30 lb) and never above 3.5 mph.
conditioning_protocols.heart_health_rationale: AHA/HHS: 150 min/week moderate (or 75 vigorous, vigorous counts x2), spread through the week, plus muscle-strengthening 2+ days (this program has 4). Honest tally of dedicated aerobic work: week 1 about 85 moderate-equivalent min (Zone 2 ~60 + brisk-walk intervals 20 + DB swings); Phase 2-3 about 125-140 (Zone 2 ~65-70, intervals 16 vigorous = 32, swing EMOM/density 8-10 vigorous = 16-20, Thursday swing sets 5 vigorous = 10). The home-screen cardio guard shows the 150 line and the optional Sunday walk (20-30 min) closes the gap; with it, every phase clears 150.

conditioning_protocols.name: Saturday intervals (HIC)
conditioning_protocols.protocol: 2 min easy walk, current treadmill_intervals step, 2 min easy walk = 18-20 min. Phase 1 weeks 1-2 locked to brisk-walk step 1; jogging only at step 3. Weeks 4, 8, 12: replaced by the Boss Battle script (mile test first).
conditioning_protocols.progression: Advance per ladder (completed x2, no pain flag, Zone 2 step >= 2). Running minutes never rise more than 10% week to week. Health-screen 'yes' locks intervals until the user confirms clearance.
conditioning_protocols.heart_health_rationale: One weekly vigorous session raises VO2max and lowers resting HR fastest in untrained adults; VO2max is among the strongest predictors of cardiovascular mortality. Walk-based start for 2 weeks reduces cardiac and musculoskeletal risk.

conditioning_protocols.name: Swing EMOM and S&S density clock (Thu sets + Sat block)
conditioning_protocols.protocol: Thursday: 5 sets at the swing ladder step, 60 s rest. Saturday: steps 1-5 run an 8-min EMOM alternating 8 DB swings (odd minutes) and 8 goblet squats at current step (even minutes); step 8 runs 8x10 EMOM; steps 9-11 run the density clock (100 swings for time, app stopwatch, 30 s bells).
conditioning_protocols.progression: Per swing ladder; every set carries the 5-item checklist; 3 consecutive broken reps end the set. Thresholds 8:00 -> 6:00 -> 5:00; one-hand swings only after 100 in 5:00 twice and no low-back flag in 14 days.
conditioning_protocols.heart_health_rationale: Hard-style swings hit 85-90% HRmax with zero impact, adding 8-15 vigorous minutes weekly while training the hinge, grip and posterior chain.

benchmarks.name: Boss Battle 1: Max push-ups in 2 minutes
benchmarks.protocol: Full push-ups (chest to fist height, lockout); rest only in top plank. Users on push_up.step <= 3 test knee push-ups scored 0.5 each. First test of the Saturday script after warm-up. Co-op: duo score = sum of both users' tier points (recruit 1 ... champion 4).

benchmarks.name: Boss Battle 2: Swings in 5 minutes with your earned implement
benchmarks.protocol: Two-hand swings to chest height, any rest scheme, 5-min cap, checklist enforced (3 broken reps end the test). Implement = the user's current swing ladder implement: 20 lb DB (tier capped at recruit), 35 lb DB (capped at soldier), 53 lb bell (uncapped). Never a deadlift fallback. Fourth test, 3 min rest before.

benchmarks.name: Boss Battle 3: 1-mile treadmill time
benchmarks.protocol: 1% incline, 3 min walk warm-up, then 1.00 mile as fast as possible, walk/run mix allowed, no rails. Replaces the Saturday interval block on test weeks (done first, then 8 min rest).

benchmarks.name: Boss Battle 4: Max hollow hold
benchmarks.protocol: Full hollow (legs straight, arms overhead, back flat); timer stops when the low back lifts or legs drop below 6 in. Users on hollow_hold.step <= 3 test the tuck hollow at 0.5x seconds. Second test, 3 min rest.

benchmarks.name: Boss Battle 5: Max unbroken goblet squats at ~30% bodyweight
benchmarks.protocol: Load = the heaviest of 12/20/35/53 lb that is <= 35% of bodyweight AND already reached in the user's goblet ladder (e.g. 120 lb user -> 35 lb; 200 lb user -> 53 lb). Thighs below parallel, no rest > 3 s at the top. If the ladder has not reached the target load, test one implement lighter and cap the tier at soldier. Third test, 3 min rest.

benchmarks.name: Boss Battle 6: Vest step-ups in 3 minutes
benchmarks.protocol: Chair step-ups, alternating legs, full hip extension, vest at 10% BW once step_up.step >= 4; before that unweighted with tier capped at soldier. Fifth and last test, 3 min rest, then cooldown.

progression_rules: DATA MODEL: each user has current_step per exercise (seeded by the placement quiz). Target grammar: 'SxR' sets x reps; 'SxA-B' rep range (prescribe A on the first session at a step, advance threshold B); 'SxR each side'; 'SxNs' seconds; 'SxA-Bs' seconds range; 'NxR EMOM'; 'N min RPE <= k'; 'N rounds'; '100 in <= m:ss'; 'checklist n/N'; compound targets joined by ' + ' are evaluated per part. Shorthand 'x2' / 'x3' in advance_when = the condition met on 2 (3) consecutive logged sessions of that exercise. Gate expressions reference other ladders as exercise_id.step >= n and are booleans the app evaluates at advance time. The template's set count always wins; the ladder step supplies reps/time/load; the advance threshold applies to every prescribed set. LOGGING per set: reps or seconds (or rounds/time for EMOM/clock), RIR 0-4, pain 0-10, checklist ticks where required. SESSION SUCCESS: every prescribed set >= the step's advance threshold, RIR >= phase minimum minus 1, no pain >= 3, checklist full. SESSION FAIL: any set < 60% of the prescribed (low-end) reps/time, or pain >= 3 on any set. ADVANCE: when advance_when is satisfied (default x2 + gates), current_step += 1, counter resets, max one advance per exercise per session, none during deload/test weeks or the first session after a > 7-day gap. WITHIN-STEP (double progression): if not all sets hit the threshold, next session's target is 'beat last time by >= 1 total rep' and the app shows last numbers per set; effort is capped by phase RIR (3/2/1). HOLD: a session that misses by a lot (any set < 60%) is a FAIL: hold the step, repeat the same prescription. STEP BACK: 2 consecutive FAILs, or pain >= 3 twice on the same exercise in 7 days -> current_step -= 1 (min 1), requires x2 to return. VEST: loads are % bodyweight rounded to the vest increment, first vest session at min(10% BW, 10 lb), +1 increment when the step target is met x2, hard cap min(20% BW, 30 lb). EQUIPMENT: if a dumbbell size is marked unavailable, its step is skipped and the previous step gains a '+1.5-rep' variant; single-dumbbell households get the single-arm/alternating 'how' automatically. MISSED TRAINING: 8-14 days away -> every non-warm-up exercise regresses 1 step and the last completed week repeats; > 14 days -> regress 2 steps and restart the current phase at week 1. XP: 10 per completed set, +25 per ladder step gained, +50 per benchmark tier gained, +5 per Zone-2 minute /10; level = floor(sqrt(XP/100)). PLACEMENT QUIZ (per user, ~60 s, seeds starting steps): Q1 max clean full push-ups: 0 -> push_up 1 (2 if 10+ wall push-ups feel easy), 1-4 -> 3, 5-9 -> 4, 10+ -> 5; diamond_push_up = push_up step - 2 (min 1); pike_push_up 1 (2 if push_up >= 4). Q2 squat test: 10 pain-free chair sit-to-stands? no -> goblet 1; yes -> 2; yes and 15 full-depth BW squats -> 3 (12 lb), or 4 (20 lb) if also bodyweight >= 160 lb; split_squat = 1, step_up = 1 (2 if goblet >= 3). Q3 plank hold: < 20 s -> plank_side_plank 1, hollow 1; 20-45 s -> 2/2; > 45 s -> 3/3; leg_raise 1. Q4 hinge: 10 wall hinges with checklist 5/5 -> hinge_deadlift 2 (12 lb RDL), else 1; swing always 1; single_leg_rdl 1; hip_thrust 1 (2 if plank > 45 s). Q5 overhead: 10 pain-free wall slides AND 10 easy overhead presses with 8 lb? fail slides -> press and pike locked at step 1 with clinician note; pass -> db_overhead_press 1 (8 lb), or 2 (10 lb) if the 8 lb x10 was 'easy', or 3 (12 lb) if male >= 160 lb and 'easy'; db_lateral_raise, db_rear_delt_fly, db_curl, db_hammer_curl, db_triceps_extension, db_floor_press: 1 (2 if 'easy'). Q6 carry: hold 20 lb in one hand 30 s without leaning? no -> db_row 1, suitcase 1, farmer 1, db_shrug 1; yes -> db_row 2 (20 lb), suitcase 2, farmer 2, db_shrug 2. Q7 cardio: 20 min walk at 3.0 mph comfortable? no -> treadmill_zone2 1 at 20 min building to 30; yes -> 1; yes and can jog 5 min -> 2; intervals always 1; vest_walk locked. Q8 kettlebell swing or get-up experience? 'no' forces swing 1 and turkish_get_up 1 regardless; 'yes' still starts swing at 1 (hike-and-park) but allows the BELL GATE checklist sessions to count from day 1. DUO MODE: shared program, per-user state files. Duo streak increments only on days both users log a session (Sunday walk counts). Weekly head-to-head compares RELATIVE progress only: XP earned this week, % of prescribed sets that hit target, ladder steps gained, Zone-2 minutes, benchmark tier deltas; absolute weight/reps never appear on the scoreboard. Co-op boss battles: combined tier points of both users vs a shared target (week 4: 8, week 8: 12, week 12: 16 of 24 max); duo badges for first duo streak of 7/30/60 days, both passing the hinge gate, both earning the bell, combined 200 swings in a test week. Partner card shows 'trained today: yes/no' from the partner's latest log file.
deload_rules: SCHEDULED: weeks 4, 8, 12 are deload + Boss Battle weeks. Mon-Fri: strength sets x0.6 (round down, min 2), RIR 4, same ladder step and load, no ladder advances or regressions evaluated, Wednesday Zone 2 at 70% duration one incline step lower, Thursday swing sets cut to 3, Monday/Thursday finisher walks kept. Saturday = fixed Boss Battle script (about 48 min): 5 min warm-up, 1-mile test, 8 min easy walk, push-ups 2 min, 3 min rest, hollow hold max, 3 min rest, goblet max, 3 min rest, swings 5 min, 3 min rest, step-ups 3 min, 4 min cooldown; if it runs long the app moves the mile to Sunday. Week 12 taper: Mon-Wed 50% sets, Thu 25-min unloaded walk, Fri off, Sat final Boss Battle. AUTO-DELOAD (app-computed, per user): (a) 2 or more exercises at FAIL across 3 consecutive sessions, (b) readiness check-in (sleep, soreness, motivation 1-5) averaging <= 2 for 3 consecutive days, (c) sleep < 6 h two nights running, (d) any pain flag >= 5, (e) 3+ pain flags in a rolling 7 days -> the next 3 sessions run at 0.6 sets, RIR 4, Zone 2 only (no intervals, no density clock), then the template resumes without advancing. Missed sessions are skipped, not stacked; 3+ missed days in a week -> next week repeats the same steps at RIR 3 for one session before advances resume.
warmup_and_mobility: Every session opens with warmup_flow: 2-3 min easy treadmill walk, dynamic mobility (leg swings/hip circles or arm circles/wall slides), 10 wall hinges EVERY day so the hinge is grooved 6x/week before the bell ever swings, then 1-2 rehearsal sets of the day's first patterns one ladder step easier (chair squats or glute bridges on lower days, easier push-ups and prone Y-T-W on upper days, 15 s hollow hold on Thursday for bracing, hike-and-park with the current swing implement on Saturday). Intervals carry 2 min easy in/out inside the block. Every session closes with cooldown_flow: 2 min easy walk where the budget allows, then static holds of 30-45 s with slow nasal breathing: couch stretch (hip flexors), hamstring, calf on lower days; chest, lat, overhead triceps, neck side-bend on upper days. Onboarding screens: shoulder (10 pain-free wall slides) gates overhead work; hip/knee (10 pain-free chair sit-to-stands) holds goblet at step 1 for 2 extra sessions if failed. First-time cards: the first session of swing, turkish_get_up, db_floor_press, hinge_deadlift step 5 and vest work shows a one-screen cue card with 'stop the set the moment form breaks' and requires the checklist before logging.
safety_and_form_gates: 1) HINGE GATE: hinge_deadlift.step >= 5 requires 12 -> 20 -> 35 lb dumbbell RDLs with the 5-item checklist x2 each; the 53 lb deadlift itself is the gate (3x10 checklist 5/5 x2). Swings start at hike-and-park with a 20 lb DUMBBELL once hinge_deadlift.step >= 3. 2) BELL GATE (53 lb swing): swing.step 5 met (35 lb DB swings 5x15 x2) AND hinge_deadlift.step >= 6 AND hollow_hold.step >= 4 (30 s full hollow). Then dead-stop 53 lb before continuous. Every swing set carries the checklist; 3 consecutive broken reps end the set; a checklist miss drops next session's reps by 2 per set; two misses regress one step. One-hand swings: 100 in 5:00 x2 and no low-back flag in 14 days. 3) HEAVY-BELL GATES: any 53 lb step in rows, shrugs, carries, SL RDL, calf, hip thrust requires hinge_deadlift.step >= 5; KB floor press and the 53 lb press require swing.step >= 7 and, for the press, 35 lb strict 3x8/side x2; the bell is racked with two hands, never cleaned. Get-up: naked and shoe steps must pass before any weight; 53 lb get-up requires swing.step >= 9. 4) VEST GATE (per exercise, evaluated as booleans): push_up.step >= 5, goblet_squat.step >= 8, split_squat.step >= 2, step_up.step >= 3, plank_side_plank.step >= 4, pike_push_up.step >= 4, diamond_push_up requires push_up.step >= 6, hinge_deadlift vest step requires vest_walk.step >= 1, vest_walk requires treadmill_zone2.step >= 4. Global: first vest session min(10% BW, 10 lb); cap min(20% BW, 30 lb); never on the treadmill above 3.5 mph. 5) RUN GATE: intervals locked at brisk-walk step 1 until treadmill_zone2.step >= 2 and 2 weeks elapsed; jogging only at step 3 with no shin/knee pain flag; running minutes rise <= 10%/week. Health-screen 'yes' (chest pain, dizziness, heart condition, uncontrolled BP) locks intervals until clearance is confirmed. 6) OVERHEAD GATE: db_overhead_press and pike_push_up require the shoulder screen; pressing starts half-kneeling with 8 lb. 7) PUSH-UP FAMILY: diamond knee step requires push_up.step >= 4. 8) PAIN RULE: pain >= 3 ends that exercise for the day; twice in 7 days regresses one step and shows a form card; >= 5 triggers the mini-deload and a 'see a clinician if it persists 7 days' notice. Chest pain, dizziness, unusual breathlessness = stop the session, medical check before resuming. 9) BENCHMARKS: no max test before week 4; the swing test uses only the implement already earned (never a deadlift fallback); goblet and step-up tests substitute lighter/unweighted with capped tiers. 10) APP ENFORCEMENT: locked exercise_ids map to fallbacks in the template (swing steps 1-5 use the dumbbell; Saturday swing block -> DB swing/goblet EMOM; vest steps -> last unweighted step; vest_walk -> treadmill_zone2); gates show as a lock icon with the exact remaining condition.
settings_needed_at_onboarding: Profile (per user): display name, which user slot (sean / cat), avatar, preferred units (lb/kg, mph/kph)
Body metrics (per user, stored LOCAL-ONLY by default): bodyweight lb, height, age (drives vest % BW, goblet test load, HR zone 220-age); optional resting HR baseline

Health screen (PAR-Q style, per user): chest pain, dizziness, diagnosed heart condition, high blood pressure, doctor-advised limits -> locks intervals until cleared; injury history flags (low back, shoulder, knee, wrist, neck) that cap starting steps and add checklist prompts
Shoulder screen result (10 pain-free wall slides yes/no) and hip/knee screen (10 pain-free chair sit-to-stands yes/no)

Placement quiz answers Q1-Q8 (max push-ups, squat test, plank hold, hinge checklist, overhead 8 lb x10 easy?, 20 lb one-hand hold 30 s?, cardio comfort, kettlebell experience) -> starting step per exercise family
Weighted vest: max weight, smallest increment, lightest setting (shared equipment, entered once, editable by either user)
Dumbbells: for each of 8/10/12/20/35 lb, PAIR or SINGLE (shared); 53 lb kettlebell confirmed
Treadmill: max incline % and max speed mph (shared); whether a HR monitor/watch is worn (per user)
Chair/step: seat height in inches and confirmation it is braced against a wall; couch edge available for hip thrusts; carry space (hallway steps or march in place)
Schedule (per user): rest day (default Sunday), preferred training time for reminders, preferred session length 40/45/50 (app trims Zone-2 finisher minutes to fit), start date (default 2026-09-08)
Readiness check-in on/off (daily sleep/soreness/motivation 1-5) and sleep-hours entry for auto-deload
Duo settings: partner slot, duo streak on/off, weekly head-to-head visibility, co-op boss battle opt-in, notification when partner trains

Sync (set up once on each phone by Sean): repo owner/name, this phone's user slot, fine-grained PAT scoped to that repo (contents read/write), commit author name for this user; app writes only users/<slot>/*.json and reads users/<other-slot>/*.json; tokens stored in device storage only
Nutrition preference (per user, optional): recomp/maintenance vs modest deficit, used only for the notes shown
risks_and_mitigations: Low-back injury from hinging/swinging: dumbbell RDL chain before the bell, dumbbell swings before the bell, hollow-hold bracing prerequisite, dead-stop before continuous, checklists every set, pain rule, no max deadlift test ever. Shoulder irritation: onboarding screen, half-kneeling 8 lb pressing, wall slides daily, rear delt/Y-T-W balance, two-hand rack (no clean), diamond gated on push-up step. Knee/shin overuse: low step-up start, 3 s eccentrics, chair braced, brisk-walk intervals for 2+ weeks, running minutes +10%/week max, vest never above 3.5 mph. Overreaching on 6 days: RIR 3 start, upper/lower alternation with Zone 2 between lower days, one vigorous day, 0.6-set deloads every 4th week, readiness/sleep auto-deload, real Sunday rest, time guard (at 50 min the app drops the last strength-B set and trims cooldown). Cardiac risk in an inactive adult: health screen, moderate-only start, stop-and-consult rules. Smaller beginner overloaded by fixed weights: every ladder starts at 8/12 lb or bodyweight, benchmarks are reps/time or % bodyweight, vest is % BW. Load gaps: tempo, pause, 1.5-rep, high-rep, unilateral and vest rungs between every jump; unavailable sizes auto-skipped. Single dumbbell: single-arm/alternating 'how' on every dumbbell lift. Shared equipment at the same time: the app offers a 'swap order' toggle that runs strength A and B blocks in reverse for one user so the bell/vest is free; both users log independently. Sync conflicts: each phone writes only its own user's files, so no file is ever edited by two devices; scoreboard reads are eventually consistent (retry on 409). Privacy: bodyweight/height/age stay in device storage unless the user opts to sync them; only steps, XP, streaks and benchmark results are pushed. Rivalry souring adherence: scoreboard shows relative metrics only, co-op targets outweigh head-to-head, duo streak rewards both showing up. Anyone with a diagnosed heart, back or joint condition should clear this plan with a clinician first.
nutrition_and_recovery_notes: Protein 0.7-1.0 g per lb of bodyweight per day over 3-4 meals (30-50 g each); this is the biggest lever for looking lean and strong on a beginner program. Calories: modest 300-500 kcal/day deficit if fat loss is the priority (expect 0.5-1 lb/week), maintenance if already lean; never a crash diet on 6 days/week. Carbs around Wednesday/Saturday and the lower days; vegetables at every meal; 2-3 L water, extra on swing days. Sleep 7-9 h with a consistent wake time; the readiness check-in and sleep entry feed the auto-deload. Creatine monohydrate 3-5 g/day is the one evidence-backed optional supplement; caffeine before Saturday is optional. Alcohol blunts recovery; keep it to the rest day if at all. Expect DOMS in weeks 1-2 (hamstrings, glutes, chest); sharp joint pain is not DOMS and should be logged. Weigh weekly and take photos every 4 weeks on benchmark day (local-only by default). Sunday is a real rest day: optional easy walk only. This is general guidance, not medical advice.
